purpose: Resolve deterministic implementation details left operationally unspecified by the frozen V1 protocol, before generating source-fit results and before any target-value access.

stability_subsamples.rule: For replicate r=0..19, sort ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING participant IDs by SHA256('RPPV1_STABILITY|r|<participant_id>') and take the first 24.

assignment_null.block_rule: For each selected discovery gene independently, permute 30 participant blocks and independently swap the two within-participant specimen positions with probability 0.5.
assignment_null.optimization: Only the frozen top-60 discovery genes are permuted because block permutation preserves every gene's univariate values and therefore preserves the MAD ranking exactly.

strict_rr_direct.base_semantics: Same repaired RR_DIRECT induction/scoring semantics as repository rr_direct.py, including strict A>B/A<B tie handling and global-prevalence contrast.
strict_rr_direct.primary_fallback: disabled: if a profile has no relation meeting frozen support/contrast thresholds, that fit fails

stability_ari.assignment: forced argmax prototype score without min_score/min_margin abstention
stability_ari.implementation: exact adjusted Rand index from contingency counts; no sklearn dependency

signature_bootstrap.ranking_median: median across all 500 draws including degenerate draws set to 0

source_reference_bootstrap.one_sided_lower_bound: 5th percentile using NumPy quantile(method='lower') across all 2000 draws

participant_group_aggregation: Within each participant and frozen group, average eligible specimen validation scores; then average participant-level values with equal participant weight.

artifact_provenance.preprocessing_hash: SHA256 of canonical mapped source matrix bytes plus sorted GSM and gene identifiers
